status_of_every_rule: development rule on previously and adaptively used records (MODEL_FIT and MODEL_SELECT were used by earlier campaigns); nothing is confirmation; no original limit changes; the reserve is reported, never gating; point feasibility is never confidence preservation; every uncertainty statement is asymptotic and model-based

inherited.module: nrm.rules imported unchanged: point_eligibility (G1), reserve_status, mc_cell / se_mc handling, aggregate, benefit_screen, target_screen, recipient_screen, comparison, frontier_comparison, robustness, claims (G4, G5, G6), alias_groups
inherited.derived_from: ddr/rules.py and the DDR1 RULES.json (pcrl_dual_design_release_v1, publication e30cf1c6b): every DDR1 rule is kept unless listed in change_record; frc logic copied via ddr (neither ddr nor frc is imported)

sign_convention: NR's: pair benefit = comparator AUC - candidate AUC (positive favours the candidate); recipient difference = candidate AUC - comparator AUC; paired costs loss(candidate) - loss(comparator) (negative favours the candidate; accuracy enters as a loss)

reader_grid.seed_rule: reader seed S<v>k<k> = MODEL_SEED_BASE + 900 + 10 v + k exactly (k0, k1 registered; k2, k3 robustness; READER_SPLITS.json keys V<v>k<k> map to S<v>k<k>); recorded distinct integers; none equal to MODEL_SEED_BASE + {300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800} + 10 v + k (k = 0..9; 120 seeds)
reader_grid.offset_900_disclosure: the +900 reader-seed base and the bootstrap base 2026102300 appear in no earlier READER_SPLITS.json of the repository (checked by text search at 01:44Z); +800 was realized by DDR1 and is forbidden
reader_grid.bootstrap_rule: household bootstrap of SCORE, B = 400, seed 2026102300 + 100 v + repetition index; bootstrap seeds are recorded per (version, repetition) as S<v><R> and must equal the registered values
reader_grid.robustness_cells: R3, R4 with k0-k3 and R1, R2 with k2, k3 (24 cells); never a decision input
reader_grid.validity: READER_SEEDS_EFFECTIVE iff the seed rule and the bootstrap rule hold and, per seed pair (k0 / k1; for the refit also k2 / k3), every seed-dependent recipe is checked, NRM1 A-SC1 (iii) explains every seed-dependent equality off the minimum set, and on the minimum set an equality is explained only by er_explanation; minimum set = a D2 reading's CAND, TWIN and the saved points of its three control paths (SBC, SPEND, RO) (for the refit: the strongest release, its TWIN and its bracketing controls of the three paths); references, ablations and D5 comparators are off it; claims need grid_valid recorded and exactly true

er_explanation.status: PROSPECTIVE (registered before any grid output); FRC1 ER1 restricted to its documented mechanism (as DDR1)
er_explanation.rule: a seed-dependent k-pair equality on the minimum set is explained iff the recipe is ET5 or ET25, NRM1 (iii) (a) + (b) + (c) hold and the recorded distinct-input count of the view is at most 8001 // min_leaf (ET5 1600, ET25 320); any other seed-dependent recipe equal on the minimum set invalidates the grid; seed pairs are judged separately; explained equalities are reported with their n_eff

decisions.configuration: CAND = the family's operation at the strength chosen by its card's MODEL_FIT-only rule (per version, before any MODEL_SELECT read); D1-D5 are read at CAND, never at another strength, the strongest release or the ablation
decisions.strength_format: a strength is a number, a component vector (for example recipient-split strengths) or a per-version dict of either; nonzero in a version iff every component is finite and >= 0 and at least one is > 0; the tie-break scalar is the sum of every component over both versions; CAND_STRENGTH_DIFFERS_BY_VERSION is flagged from cand.strength

D1.rule: as DDR1: G1 (24 clauses + 4 guards at the point, both versions) for TWIN and CAND; the reserve beside

ro_scope.SUBSTITUTED: the RO controls are the same operation driven by a release-only SEX surrogate (a function of the twin's released vectors fitted on MODEL_FIT, cross-fitted): passing RO_FRONTIER means the gain needs SEX information beyond what the twin's release carries, for the declared readers
ro_scope.GENERIC_ZTILT: the RO controls are the generic release-only tilt ZTILT of the twin, not the operation itself: passing RO_FRONTIER means the gain is not reproduced by that tilt at matched spend; the same operation driven only by the twin's release was not built
ro_scope.RELEASE_ONLY_OPERATION: the operation is itself a SEX-targeted function of the twin's released vectors: it uses no SEX information beyond the twin's release by construction; passing RO_FRONTIER means it is a better release-only map than the generic tilt ZTILT at matched spend, never information beyond the release
ro_scope.SEX_BLIND_OPERATION: the operation reads no SEX (SEX enters only through the MODEL_FIT strength-selection guards): its SBC and release-only (RO) comparisons are degenerate by construction (each would be the operation itself), so D2 was assessed against the twin and the SEX-blind spending path only; no SEX-targeting claim and no claim about SEX information beyond the twin's release is possible; a generic ZTILT path, if built, is reported beside and never gates

D2.control_paths: each control path = TWIN (strength 0) + the distinct saved points of the SBC, SPEND or RO path (aliases once; an alias of TWIN collapses into TWIN); an empty list is compared at [TWIN] (flag <key>_AT_IDENTITY); a path not given is INCOMPLETE unless recorded as not run for budget (NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN) or, for SBC only, the operation is declared SEX-blind
D2.ro_declaration: record ro = {kind: SUBSTITUTED | GENERIC_ZTILT, operation_release_only: bool} from the card, required whenever the RO path is given (else INCOMPLETE); operation_release_only true requires kind GENERIC_ZTILT (else INCOMPLETE); flags RO_<kind>, RELEASE_ONLY_OPERATION
D2.sex_blind_operation: record operation_sex_blind (bool, card; default false): the operation has no SEX-dependent fitted input (SEX only in the MODEL_FIT strength-selection guards). Its SBC path and its substituted RO path would be the operation itself (degenerate by construction): an SBC path or a SUBSTITUTED RO path given is INCOMPLETE; D2 gates on TWIN and SPEND_FRONTIER only (plus targeting vs TWIN and the SPEND Q*); met label SEX_BLIND_IMPROVEMENT_BEYOND_TWIN_AND_SPEND (scope RO_SCOPE.SEX_BLIND_OPERATION: no SEX-targeting claim); a GENERIC_ZTILT RO path, if given, is computed and reported beside, never gating; flags SEX_BLIND_OPERATION, SBC_DEGENERATE_BY_CONSTRUCTION, RO_DEGENERATE_BY_CONSTRUCTION, RO_GENERIC_ZTILT_REPORTED_BESIDE
D2.rule: met iff (a) G1 at CAND; (b) vs TWIN: nrm.rules.comparison passes; (c) for each of the SBC, SPEND and RO paths: nrm.rules.frontier_comparison = DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER AND the recipient gate vs Q* AND no cheaper path point resolved less recoverable than CAND; (d) the non-table winner's point pair benefit > 0 in both version means vs TWIN and every gating Q*; met label SEX_BLIND_IMPROVEMENT_BEYOND_TWIN_AND_SPEND for a declared SEX-blind operation (gating: TWIN and SPEND only), RELEASE_ONLY_MAP_BEYOND_MATCHED_CONTROLS when ro.operation_release_only, else IMPROVEMENT_BEYOND_MATCHED_CONTROLS; every sentence quoting a D2 label carries its scope (D2 record field scope = ro.scope)
D2.labels: in order: NOT_ASSESSED_NO_FEASIBLE_STRENGTH; NOT_ASSESSED_EXACT_ALIAS; INCOMPLETE (CAND status or utility); NOT_ASSESSED_TASK_INFEASIBLE; NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_VALIDITY_UNKNOWN / NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_INVALID; INCOMPLETE (operation_sex_blind not boolean, or an SBC path given for a SEX-blind operation); NOT_ASSESSED_CONTROLS_NOT_RUN (a gating path not run for budget); INCOMPLETE (RO declaration, a SUBSTITUTED RO path for a SEX-blind operation, any needed input); READER_TARGETED; the met label; NOT_SEPARATED (no gating comparison passes); PARTIAL_<passed, joined by +, in the order TWIN, SBC_FRONTIER, SPEND_FRONTIER, RO_FRONTIER>_ONLY
flags: CONTROL_GRID_COARSE_<key> / CONTROL_PATH_MAY_NOT_BRACKET_<key> / CONTROL_POINT_RULE_NOT_FOLLOWED_<key> / CONTROL_GRID_FINENESS_INCOMPLETE_<key> (from grid_fineness; reported)

grid_fineness.rule: per path and version on MODEL_FIT, before any MODEL_SELECT read: with s = CAND's out-of-fold paired total-NLL spend over TWIN (> 0) and SE the household-clustered SE of the paired difference upper - CAND, FINE iff the saved lower point spends >= 0.75 s (and <= s) and the saved upper point spends >= s + 2 SE and <= s + 2 SE + 0.25 s; CONTROL_PATH_MAY_NOT_BRACKET if the path's largest grid spend < s + 2 SE; NOT_APPLICABLE_CAND_NOT_ABOVE_TWIN if s <= 0; reported, never gating

D2.partial: no partial outcome is a claim; NOT_SEPARATED is the default reading, never "equal"
D2.power: per comparison, 2 se_agg is the resolution threshold (0.018-0.036 at the se_agg 0.009-0.018 realized on this grid design) and about 2.84 se_agg (0.026-0.051) is the benefit resolved with roughly 80% power; D2 needs four resolved comparisons plus targeting, so its power is lower, and lowest when the release-only control reproduces part of the gain; "not separated" is the default reading, never "equal"

D2R.rule: as DDR1 with the decisive set {TWIN, the strongest release's own bracketing controls of the SBC, SPEND and RO paths}; a path bracket not recorded (absent key, or a brackets() record with status INCOMPLETE) gives INCOMPLETE; ROBUSTNESS_CONFIRMED needs nrm.rules.robustness confirmed on the merged registered + robustness cells and REFIT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE; descriptive; never changes D2

D3.rule: NRM1 G4 at CAND with the reader-budget credit rule (as DDR1); the dual-design releases are reported beside, never members

D4.rule: NRM1 G5 at CAND with the reader-budget credit rule for the two targets; met iff MATERIAL_0020_RESOLVED

D5.rule: NRM1 G6 unchanged on rec.joint (NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_JOINT when the card declares no joint design; NOT_APPLICABLE_ONE_OUTPUT_CHANGED; NOT_ASSESSED_MISSING_CONTROLS when a comparator is not named; JOINT_CONTRIBUTION_SUPPORTED / NOT_SUPPORTED), except INCOMPLETE when a declared joint design names all three comparators but a grid entry (pair or a recipient view) or paired cost of one is missing; gated like D3 / D4 (carries D2's NOT_ASSESSED_* / NOT_COMPUTED_* gate label; INCOMPLETE when CAND is not fitted or not G1-eligible); never changes the outcome class
D5.collapsed_orders: joint.collapsed = {income_first | occupation_first: SEPARATE | JOINT}, declared in the card before its first fit with the construction argument: an order equal to the joint design gives NOT_APPLICABLE_JOINT_EQUALS_SEQUENTIAL (no joint-design claim possible); an order equal to the separate design is replaced by the separate comparator (reduced test; NR G6 label; flag D5_REDUCED_<ORDER>_EQUALS_SEPARATE); another comparator named for a collapsed order, or a malformed declaration, is INCOMPLETE; without a declaration an order that is not built is not named and NR gives NOT_ASSESSED_MISSING_CONTROLS

decisions.D6: NOT_CLAIMED unless a separate prior-art review supplies NOVELTY_REVIEW_PENDING / NOVEL_PER_SEPARATE_REVIEW / PRIOR_ART_FOUND; never inferred from performance

outcome_class.rule: as DDR1 (first applicable: TASK_INFEASIBLE; SELECTED_STRENGTH_INFEASIBLE; INCOMPLETE; PROTECTION_NOT_ASSESSED; CANDIDATE; COMPONENT; TASK_ONLY_FEASIBLE_NO_PROTECTION); D2 met means either met label; D4 and D5 never change the class; ro_scope is carried with the class

registration_status.registered: a reading is registered iff it is revision 0 of IA or IB and its card was committed before any MODEL_SELECT outcome of this campaign; a family name other than IA, IB or FS_<letters/digits> is refused
registration_status.tag: otherwise <KIND>_<parts> as DDR1 (REVISED / ADAPTIVE; FS, R<n>, R0_LATE_CARD); every label prefixed <tag>__
registration_status.multiplicity: one AGG_POSITIVE comparison passes a true null in about 0.07-2% of replicates under six moderate NRM1 known laws and about 8% when one version or split dominates (NRM1 RULES.md 5.5); a D2 look is an intersection-union conjunction of four such comparisons (TWIN, SBC, SPEND, RO), so its false-pass rate is at most that of its weakest member; with K D2 looks the chance that at least one passes by chance is at most K times the per-look rate

scope: Lower recovery for the declared development readers is not protection against every reader.
MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used: development evidence, never confirmation.
Versions share training rows; repetitions share households; reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets.
A reserve-frontier result is not superiority over every historical method.
Novelty is never inferred from performance.
Point feasibility and the reserve are not confidence preservation.
A revision or replacement-family reading is never the registered result.
A release-only map that passes RO_FRONTIER uses no SEX information beyond the twin's release; only a SUBSTITUTED RO path tests information beyond the release.
